webhooks.detail: App webhooks configured as app features; pick subscribed events (inbound_received, conversation_moved, outbound_sent, tag_added, assignee_changed, new_comment_added, etc). Also rule webhooks and application triggers.

evidence.quote: Application webhooks are configured as features on the apps you create on the Developers page in Front.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox, test mode or free developer account wording found in Front dev docs. Apps are created inside an existing Front company by an admin; local testing via ngrok.

evidence.quote: You must be a company admin to create or manage apps.

rate_limits.summary: 50 req/min default (Starter), 100 Professional, 200 Enterprise; per company; extra burst guards on some endpoints

evidence.quote: By default, Front's API rate limit starts at 50 requests per minute and varies depending on your plan.
This repo provides Front Platform API schemas for public consumption.
